behavior: Expose commit-pinned Graphify index evaluation and edge policy from @structile/agent-harness so stale, unverifiable or inferred-only context can never be treated as evidence.
nonGoals: No Graphify index construction, extraction or indexing service
No network access and no Graphify API client
No changes to the adapter, transport or evidence code paths
No planning, requirement or catalog edits
notes: First micro-task under the delivery operating model section 8 step 7: a thin, already-specified G1 behavior chosen to prove the contract/task-ready/verifier loop end to end. The protected HAR-004 suite (structile-conformance#19, merged) already asserts the exact surface: exports evaluateGraphifyIndex, assertEdgeUsable, GRAPHIFY_EXTRACTOR_VERSION and GraphifyPolicyError; a current index is usable context and never evidence; commit, repository, extractor-version and content-hash mismatches are ignored with a recorded reason; a missing index degrades to unusable; INFERRED or malformed edges are refused with GraphifyPolicyError while RESOLVED edges with a source reference are accepted. re-pinned 2026-08-25 after conformance and core both moved: testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main 46c8cf99cbac5d0c87729e08db20bbadbe2bacd0 as computed by the runner itself, the same value the five merged HAR durability contracts carry; a pending conformance re-sync of the amended catalog will move it again, and it is re-pinned then in one pass; runnerDigest is the attested G0 runner image pending a G1 runner attestation, and task-ready v1 does not verify either digest. Separately, runnerDigest carries the attested G0 runner image digest because no G1 runner digest exists yet: the protected G1 workflow builds the image fresh from Containerfile and computes imageDigest from the built image, and conformance src/ and verification/ have grown substantially since the G0 authority commit, so the G1 image's digest will differ. task-ready v1 verifies neither digest, but readiness against a real protected run requires the pinned runner to match, so this field is a placeholder to be re-pinned to the first attested G1 runner digest. Every task contract merged to date carries the same placeholder.
